t_advice_summary_textbox.text: certain gnomes lead to specific coloured baskets, the numbers in each basket change, red is generally better, its better to stick with the same colour whilst the points are good or look at other baskets whilst its just 1x

vb_textbox.text: there are 8 different colour gnomes, 4 lead you to a red basket, the other 4 lead to a yelloe basket. keep selecting the same colour basket until the number decreases, once the number decreases change to the other colour basket
